parameters.help_en:
The parameter type. Valid values:

normal: not encrypted.
md5: MD5-encrypted
parameters.help_zh:
参数类型：

normal：不加密。
md5：md5加密
parameters.name: param_type

parameters.help_en:
The phone number. Valid values:
If paramType is set to normal, pass in the phone number in plaintext.
If paramType is set to md5, pass in the phone number in ciphertext
parameters.help_zh:
手机号：
paramType 传 normal 时：传入手机号明文。
paramType 传 md5 时：传入手机号密文
parameters.name: mobile

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure
Code.description_zh: 返回码：200为成功，其他为失败

BizCode.description_en:
The verification result code. Valid values:
1: Consistent.
2: Inconsistent.
3: No record found
BizCode.description_zh:
核验结果码。
1：核验一致
2：核验不一致
3：查无记录

IspName.description_en:
The name of the telecommunications service provider. Valid values:

CMCC: China Mobile. 
CUCC: China Unicom. 
CTCC: China Telecom
IspName.description_zh:
运营商名称

CMCC：移动 
CUCC：联通 
CTCC：电信

TimeCode.description_en:
The network duration code. Valid values:
1: [0,3) indicates a network duration of 0 to 3 months.
2: [3,6) indicates a network duration of 3 to 6 months.
3: [6,12) indicates a network duration of 6 to 12 months.
4: [12,24) indicates a network duration of 12 to 24 months.
5: [24,+) indicates a network duration of more than 24 months
TimeCode.description_zh:
1:[0,3)表示在网时长是 0~3 个月 
2: [3,6)表示在网时长是 3~6 个月 
3: [6,12)表示在网时长是 6~12 个月 
4: [12,24)表示在网时长是 12~24 月 
5: [24,+)表示在网时长是 24 个月以上
